Priya K.: Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands infra segment: a few Qs on eu-west3 GPU supply and autoscale behavior. Posting answers here.

Ben T.: Short summary: H100 inventory in eu-west3 is constrained for ~2 weeks; us-west1 A10G capacity is available for burst.

Sam R.: Whats the official fallback order?

Marta L.: Fallbacks (default): 1) same-region compatible nodes 2) smaller in-region model 3) cross-region quantized model (only if route allows).

Eli G.: Implementation note: routes have `prefer_local_capacity` (true) and `allow_cross_region_burst` (false by default).

Priya K.: Can cross-region be enabled per-route?

Marta L.: Yes  edit route advanced config -> set `allow_cross_region_burst: true` and optionally `fallback_model`.

Ben T.: We will publish a latency delta matrix (median/95p) for cross-region fallbacks between eu-west3 <-> us-west1 and ap-southeast1. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Sam R.: Are region-locked customers impacted?

Eli G.: No. `region_locked` tenants are excluded from cross-region routing.

Sam R.: Any maintenance that could affect H100s?

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: eu-west3 kernel rollout at 1917180000 UTC; 30-45m impact for non-critical nodes. Critical serving pools protected.

Priya K.: Thanks all  Ben, Marta, Eli please follow up with the matrix and doc links in this thread. If you had live Qs that didnt get answered, drop them here.
